pristine.sourcePolicy: byte-exact pinned upstream typetests for every adapted or pristine-only disposition

adapted.sourcePolicy: structurally equivalent after permitted import-root and query-type-package transformations for every adapted disposition

fileDispositions.rationale: ClientProvider/useClient are on the Octane public boundary; one-for-one adapted under typetests/__typetests__/.
useClientCapability is on the Octane public boundary; one-for-one adapted under typetests/__typetests__/.
useRequestQuery is ported over @octanejs/tanstack-query; one-for-one adapted under typetests/query/__typetests__/.
Selected-wallet React context is replaced by structural createWalletStore; pristine lane still typechecks the upstream artifact against React, and adaptedEvidence pins the Octane replacement types.
Sign-in hooks are replaced by createTransactionExecutor; pristine lane retains the upstream typetest, adaptedEvidence pins the Octane executor types.
Sign-and-send hooks are replaced by createTransactionExecutor; pristine lane retains the upstream typetest, adaptedEvidence pins the Octane executor types.
Sign-transaction hooks are replaced by createTransactionExecutor; pristine lane retains the upstream typetest, adaptedEvidence pins the Octane executor types.
useRequest is not ported; request UI goes through useRequestQuery. Pristine lane retains the upstream typetest for the unported surface.
Streamed TanStack subscription adapter is deferred for this pin; pristine lane still typechecks the upstream artifact.
Streamed TanStack tracked-data adapter is deferred for this pin; pristine lane still typechecks the upstream artifact.
Non-TanStack subscription hook is deferred with the streamed query surface; pristine lane still typechecks the upstream artifact.
Non-TanStack tracked-data hook is deferred with the streamed query surface; pristine lane still typechecks the upstream artifact.
Internal upstream helper; not exported by @octanejs/solana-kit.

permittedTransformations.rule: TypeScript printer output must remain structurally identical
relative upstream hook imports retarget Octane src/hooks/useClient or src/query
Matching @ts-expect-error controls must reject the same invalid call shapes on both sides
